description: 企鹅号图文发布流程（v1.7.5：新增 AI 生成声明弹窗处理——有图片时点击'进行补充'→'提交'完成声明，再点发布）

steps.descript: 导航到企鹅号文章编辑页（会加载上次草稿，后续步骤会清空）
等待编辑器加载（标题或正文任一出现即可）
填写标题（fill 会自动替换已有内容）
粘贴正文（先 Ctrl+A+Delete 清空草稿，再剪贴板粘贴 HTML）
检查是否存在AI生成声明提示（有图片时才会出现'进行补充'链接）

branch_steps.value: const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ai__declaration] a')); const link = links.find(a => (a.innerText||'').includes('进行补充')); if (link) { link.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); link.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'not found';
branch_steps.descript: 点击AI声明'进行补充'链接打开声明弹窗
等待AI声明弹窗的提交按钮出现

branch_steps.value: const dialog = document.querySelector('[class*=aidialog]'); if (!dialog) return 'dialog not found'; const btn = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button.omui-button--primary')).find(b => (b.innerText||'').trim() === '提交'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'submitted'; } return 'submit button not found';
branch_steps.descript: 点击AI声明弹窗的'提交'按钮
等待AI声明提交完成、弹窗关闭

steps.value: var bodyText = document.body.innerText || ''; if (bodyText.indexOf('请选择自主声明') < 0) return 'no_self_declaration_needed'; var allElements = document.querySelectorAll('div, span, label, li, button, a, select, option'); var declarationLabel = null; for (var i = 0; i < allElements.length; i++) { var el = allElements[i]; var t = (el.innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '自主声明' || t === '请选择自主声明' || t.indexOf('自主声明') >= 0) { declarationLabel = el; break; } } if (!declarationLabel) return 'label_not_found'; var container = declarationLabel; for (var level = 0; level < 5 && container; level++) { var trigger = container.querySelector('[class*=select], [class*=dropdown], [class*=picker], [role=combobox], [role=listbox], select, .omui-select, .omui-select-selection, [class*=omui-select]'); if (trigger) { trigger.click(); break; } container = container.parentElement; } await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 500); }); var options = document.querySelectorAll('.omui-select-dropdown-menu-item, li[class*=select-option], div[class*=option], [role=option], .omui-select-item, [class*=dropdown-item]'); var target = null; for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) { var t = (options[i].innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '取材网络' || t.indexOf('取材网络') >= 0) { target = options[i]; break; } } if (!target) { for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) { var t = (options[i].innerText || '').trim(); if (t && t.length < 20) { target = options[i]; break; } } } if (target) { target.click(); return 'selected: ' + (target.innerText || '').trim(); } var allCandidates = document.querySelectorAll('div, span, label, li, button, a'); for (var i = 0; i < allCandidates.length; i++) { var el = allCandidates[i]; var t = (el.innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '取材网络') { el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); el.click(); return 'fallback_selected: ' + t; } } return 'option_not_found';
steps.descript: v3.7.13 选择自主声明（先打开下拉菜单，再选择'取材网络'，兼容多种UI结构）
等待自主声明选择生效

steps.selector: //button[contains(@class,'omui-button--primary') and text()='发布'] | //button[contains(@class,'omui-button--primary') and not(contains(text(),'定时')) and not(contains(text(),'草稿'))]
steps.descript: 点击发布按钮（排除定时发布按钮）
v3.7.10 等待可能的AI生成声明弹窗自动弹出
v3.7.10 检测点击发布后是否自动弹出AI生成声明弹窗

branch_steps.value: var dialog = document.querySelector('[class*=aidialog]') || Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog], .omui-dialog, .omui-modal')).find(d => (d.innerText||'').indexOf('AI生成') >= 0 || (d.innerText||'').indexOf('人工智能生成') >= 0); if (!dialog) return 'dialog not found'; var btn = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button.omui-button--primary, button')).find(b => (b.innerText||'').trim() === '提交'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'submitted'; } return 'submit button not found';
branch_steps.descript: v3.7.10 点击AI声明弹窗的提交按钮（覆盖发布后自动弹出场景）
等待AI声明提交完成、弹窗关闭

steps.value: for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); var hasPublish = false; for (var j = 0; j < btns.length; j++) { var t = (btns[j].innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '发布' || t === '定时发布') { hasPublish = true; break; } } if (!hasPublish) { return 'publish_btn_disappeared'; } if (window.location.href.indexOf('articleManage') >= 0) { return 'url_changed'; } var toasts = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="toast"], [class*="message"], [class*="notification"], [class*="tip"]'); for (var k = 0; k < toasts.length; k++) { var tt = (toasts[k].innerText || '').trim(); if (tt.indexOf('发布成功') >= 0 || tt.indexOf('已发布') >= 0 || tt.indexOf('提交成功') >= 0) { return 'toast_success: ' + tt.slice(0, 50); } } await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1000); }); } return 'timeout_30s_btn_still_visible';
steps.descript: v3.7.13 发布成功检测（按钮消失/URL跳转/成功提示，三重检测）
v3.7.13 兜底等待 URL 跳转
